## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
```

## Data 

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stat870/fall2025/refs/heads/main/data/fecal_egg_counts.csv"
dat <- read.csv(url) |>  
  mutate(across(c(tx, lact, manure, past_lact), 
                ~as.factor(.))) 
dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(fec))+
  geom_histogram(aes(group = tx, fill = tx), 
                 alpha = .5, color = "black", binwidth = 2)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100))+
  scico::scale_fill_scico_d(palette = "hawaii")+
  labs(fill = "Treatment")+
  theme_pubclean()
```


```{r}
hist(rpois(n = 10^6, lambda = 10))
```

```{r}
hist(rpois(n = 10^6, lambda = .02))
```



```{r}
dat |> 
  group_by(province, herd, tx) |> 
  summarise(n())
```


```{r}
m_pois <- glmmTMB(fec ~ tx + lact + manure + tx:manure +
                    (1|province/herd), 
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          REML = TRUE,
          data = dat)
```

```{r}
plot(predict(m_pois), resid(m_pois))
```


```{r}
DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_pois, plot = T)
```

```{r}
dat |> filter(fec == 0) |> nrow()
```

```{r}
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(m_pois, plot = T)
```


```{r}
m_pois_zi <- glmmTMB(fec ~ tx + lact + manure + tx:manure +
                    (1|province/herd), 
                    ziformula = ~1,
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          REML = TRUE,
          data = dat)
```


```{r}
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(m_pois_zi, plot = T)
```

```{r}
DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_pois_zi, plot = T)
```



```{r}
m_nb_zi <- glmmTMB(fec ~ tx + lact + manure + tx:manure +
                    (1|province/herd), 
                    ziformula = ~1,
          family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
          REML = TRUE,
          data = dat)
```



```{r}
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(m_nb_zi, plot = T)
```

```{r}
DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_nb_zi, plot = T)
```

## inference 

```{r}
summary(m_pois_zi)
```

```{r}
plot(emmeans(m_pois_zi, ~ tx, type = "response"))
```


```{r}
emmeans(m_pois_zi, ~ tx, type = "response", 
        contr = list(c(1, -1)))
```
